en: Vintage sepia-tone postcard showing a wide river flowing between steep, rocky, and bush-covered hills. The water surface is rough, suggesting rapids. The image occupies the left half of the card, with large blank space on the right for writing. Printed captions in red identify the river and the rapids, and a vertical publisher credit is printed along the left margin.
